title: Craft holed by gunfire over Los Alamos

tellings.quote: My only theory, and that's all it is, is perhaps that whole uh like I said earlier, may have been a a a weapon, a 50 caliber rifle, machine gun or whatever when it was flying over Los Alamos, and maybe mass decompression,

plain: The researcher Scott Ramsey suggests that a craft said to have crashed in 1948 may have been hit by gunfire, perhaps a .50 calibre machine gun, while flying over Los Alamos, the New Mexico atomic weapons site, and that sudden loss of cabin pressure followed. Ramsey tells Michels plainly that this is only his theory. It would explain, he thinks, why the craft came down and what happened to those on board.
